verdict.rationale: Inside the product, Gusto documents Gus, an AI Benefits Assistant that gives personalized, real-time benefits guidance and instant answers. It also documents 'intelligent' payroll automations that flag anomalies in payroll data for owner review. Both appear only as one-line press-release claims and cover narrow domains; the broader 'ask questions and generate reports' capability runs through external tools like Claude and ChatGPT, not inside Gusto. Missing for 10: broad AI-generated insights across the user's business data inside Gusto, detail on how the anomaly flagging and suggestions work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
